summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would rename the War Precautions Act Repeal Act 1920 to identify its remaining role in authorising regulations that protect the word Anzac.
It would revise both the long and short titles and remove inoperative sections and headings left in the legislation from its earlier purposes.
It would commence on Royal Assent, leaving the Act’s remaining operative role as the statutory authority for regulations protecting the word Anzac.
changes: The long title would describe protection of the word Anzac and related matters.
An explanatory note would accompany the change to the Act’s short title.
Section 2 and sections 11 to 13 would be repealed as unnecessary provisions.
summary.affected: The Act authorising the Protection of Word Anzac Regulations and its remaining inoperative provisions are affected.
